# Shibari — the work becomes a request for attention

**Nature: Manipulator.** Open one reviewable PR and hand it to [`en`](../en/SKILL.md).
Shibari is [`mukai`](../mukai/SKILL.md) step 8; it proves nothing itself. The landing report
reads the opened PR.

## 0. Standalone entry

Cold entry follows [STANDALONE-ENTRY](../../../docs/STANDALONE-ENTRY.md) § 4: add P1 and P2.
The branch must be pushed; unpushed commits stop at `$aka`. Name unavailable checks.

## 1. Invocation and authority

**P1 — this run opens with `$ten shibari`** ([`ten`](../ten/SKILL.md) § 6 catches up this phase's
missing prerequisites under its own name; the phases this run calls skip theirs).

```
$shibari
```

No arguments: branch and commits identify the effort; § 2 supplies the base. The maintainer's
`$mukai` or `$shibari` call authorizes opening **one** PR and the declared evidence publish
step ([WORKFLOW](../../../docs/WORKFLOW.md) § 4). Two efforts stop at `$jujisho`.
For a public-mirror publish, announce the output first. Its `-y` only skips its own prompt.
Without a consumer grant, report `permission stop: expected — <consumer> declares no allow row for <script>`;
never G5. [Mukai](../mukai/SKILL.md) § 1 owns grants (HA#101).

## 2. The parameters, defaults stated

| Key | File | Used for | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `branch.base` | `nen/workflow.json` | the PR's base, and the `origin/<base>...HEAD` range every section is computed over | `main` |
| `commits.allowedAttributionTrailers` | `nen/workflow.json` | the truthful canonical persona/plane trailer | `Hatsu-Agent`, `Akatsuki-Agent` |
| `pr.sections.max` / `.variants` / `$sections` | `nen/workflow.json` | reader cap and consumer-owned ordered cells, filled from the catalogue with every id and purpose | seven; the full kind × family matrix |
| `coverage.*` | `nen/workflow.json` | the band the checklist quotes from `byakugan` | 80/85/90 |
| `project.evidence.globs`/`.scene`/`.mechanism` | `nen/contract.json` | the `UZF-26` rows, scene naming, and which mechanism the stack is on | **no globs is the no-evidence case**, stated in the body; `{suite}-{scene}`; **the committed-path mechanism**, never the mirror |

- A missing configuration item is asked for and set up inline (`missing-configuration`;
  [`WORKFLOW.md`](../../../docs/WORKFLOW.md) § 4 *Ask, set up, continue*); both files are read and
  validated as [`PROCESS.md`](../../../docs/PROCESS.md) § *Invocation and parsing* says.
- **The range is `origin/<branch.base>...HEAD`, after `git -C <path> fetch origin <branch.base>`** —
  nothing fast-forwards *local* `main`, and **`nen gate derive` and
  `nen changelog fragment-required` take `--files-from` (WORKFLOW § *Gate derivation*).**
- The evidence rows are `mukai` step 7's (`nen shu evidence`), **re-used, never re-derived**.

## 3. The body

**A published injected attribution trailer** ([`aka`](../aka/SKILL.md) § 7, zheref/hatsu#66) goes
in `## Completion checklist` as `injected attribution trailer: <sha> <key>, published before the switch; not rewritten`.

**Resolve before drafting** through [PR-SECTIONS.md](../../../docs/PR-SECTIONS.md):
`nen repo classify` gives kind; associated issues give distinct `job/` labels. Read consumer-owned
`pr.sections`, reuse Mukai's run facts, then run the interim resolver with
`--repo`, `--kind`, `--jobs`, applicable `--evidence`, `--economics`, `--policy-hit`, `--idle`, and
`--out <absolute-requirements.json>`. `--idle` adds the decisions section for an idle run's pre-answers
(HR-334); `--decisions` for any other decision taken for the maintainer, attended or mid-run
(zheref/hatsu#474 AC-1), which no nen manifest records (PR-SECTIONS step 3). The
resolver's printed ids give order; its array governs this write.
`contracts/pr-sections.json` owns titles, glyphs, fragments and matrix; fill `templates/pr-body/<id>.md`.

That page owns each section's content (*Write for the decision*), the seven-reader cap and the
prose budget (*Check every write*). Screenshots stay in the
[UZF-26 table](../../../docs/WORKFLOW.md#the-uzf-26-evidence-shape); replace all Evidence on rewrite.

**A closing issue's `Spec:` line** (spec-repo.md § *The PR Spec section*, matched whole) adds `--spec`.

**Delivery is the first heading**, before the first reader section, `What this changes for you`.
In the authoring worktree, save `nen report data --repo <path> --base origin/<branch.base> --effort <branch> --json`
under `<path>/.nen/reports/` (0700/0600). Run `node "$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_delivery.ts" normalize --data <report-data.json>
--out <normalized.json> --repo <path> [--gate-forecast <G2|G4>]`; the optional gate token comes
only from `nen gate derive`'s first line. Render with `nen report render --template
"$hatsu_root/templates/pr-delivery.md" --data <normalized.json> --out <repo-local-delivery.md> --repo <path>`;
paste the block, typing no cell.
WORKFLOW § *The effort's ledgers* owns model provenance, the public Source cell (locator,
timestamp, optional phase) and what stays local.
After opening, rerun report data with the actual PR (`--target <owner/name> --prs <n>`), normalize with the same derived
gate, render, edit the PR body and read it back. Drive names `$en on <CODE>#<N>` and states
readiness is `nen pr ready`'s verdict. The guard compares ledger rows and Drive to the rendered
expectation, using the derived gate and actual PR reference after opening.

**Associated issues — body AND Development** (ruling 2026-09-12):

- **Every** addressed issue is in the body table (canonical URL, scope, closed-vocabulary *Merging
  this* verdict) at creation, amendment and handover; list prerequisites separately and say when none.
- **Only a closing row is in Development** (zheref/hatsu#203): `Closes <ref>` on a default-branch PR,
  else the sidebar; a body mention is not proof. Never invent a link verb or infer `Part of #N` links.
- **Linking differs from completion**: preserve partial scope and auto-close settings; report any
  auto-close conflict for maintainer disposition before merge.

**Agent attribution** is final, as [`docs/AGENT-ATTRIBUTION.md`](../../../docs/AGENT-ATTRIBUTION.md)
specifies: actual participants only, never inferred from branch, reviewer request or model label.

## 4. Open and check

```bash
git -C <path> fetch origin <branch>
git -C <path> rev-parse HEAD refs/remotes/origin/<branch>  # the two MUST be equal
nen repo resolve --repo <path> --from <path>  # -> <owner>/<name> (<CODE>)
nen ref format --code <CODE> --kind PR --number <n>
"$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_body_sections_check.sh" --body <abs path> --requirements <absolute-requirements.json> --max <resolved-max>
"$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_body_delivery_check.sh" --body <abs path> --repo <path> \
  [--base <ref>] --gate-forecast <G2|G4>  # before create: PR unread
"$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_body_delivery_check.sh" --body <abs path> --repo <path> \
  --pr <n> --target <owner/name> [--base <ref>] --gate-forecast <G2|G4>  # after open/edit
"$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_body_evidence_check.sh" --body <abs path>
nen pr body-check --body-from <abs path> --requirements-from <absolute-requirements.json>
nen spec coverage --issue-body <abs issue.md> --pr-body <abs path> [--test-report <file>] --json  # --spec
"$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_development_link_check.sh" --body <abs path> --target <owner/name>
nen changelog fragment-required --repo <path> --spec-paths <specPaths> --fragment-dir <fragmentDir> \
  --head-changelog <headChangelog> --files-from <abs list> [--body-from <abs path>]
nen pr open --target <owner/name> --base <branch.base> --title-file <abs> --body-file <abs> \
  [--head <branch>] [--dry-run] [--json]  # title-file: the one commit's subject
nen pr edit-body --target <owner/name> --pr <n> --body-file <abs path> [--dry-run] [--json]
"$hatsu_root/scripts/pr_development_link_check.sh" --pr <owner/name#n> --base <branch.base>
nen pr converge --target <owner/name> --pr <n> --requirements-from "$hatsu_root/contracts/issue-sections.json" --json  # HR-11
```

- **HEAD must equal `origin/<branch>`**; else stop and name which is ahead. `pr open` exits `2` for
  an unpushed head, `0` adopting this head's open PR, else `1`; open once, never as draft
  (ROSTER, 2026-10-04).
- **Inputs and gate sets are [`contracts/pr-composition.json`](../../../contracts/pr-composition.json)'s**
  (zheref/hatsu#171). Fix `body-check` exit `1`; `fragment-required` follows its `changelogFragment`.
- **Derive the gate** per [`WORKFLOW.md`](../../../docs/WORKFLOW.md) § *Gate derivation*;
  report it as a forecast. Shibari neither labels a gate nor writes `readiness`;
  `en` quotes `nen pr ready` after this run.
- **Spec coverage** (`--spec`): anything but `accounted` is **G5**, row `spec-coverage` (an absent verb: a wiring stop).
- **The body is written only after sections, Delivery, Nen body-check, evidence, Spec, Development and changelog checks pass, before every create and edit.** The create is the first write and
  **every later revision is an edit**: `nen pr edit-body` replaces the body outright and **certifies
  the number before any write**, refusing a 404/410. The body file is **absolute**
  (a relative one resolves against `--repo`).
- **Development guard**: `--body` before each write, `--pr` after open/edit; fix refusals in body
  or sidebar. Off the default branch it says `retarget-pending` or `not-applicable`. Re-runs:
  `en` §§ 4–5, `sharingan` § 4.
- **`pr converge --json`** (HR-11) after open/edit. A `1` with `closingSource`
  `none-on-non-default-base` and no other `blocking` line is not applicable as `en` § 4 reads it
  (HR-357); hand over. Any other `1`: fix the verify table, `edit-body`, re-run. Re-runs: `en` §§ 4–5.

## 5. Reviewers, and the hand to `en`

```bash
nen pr request-reviews --target <owner/name> --pr <n> --add-reviewers <a,b> [--add-bots <id,...>]
```

**Reviewer-round policy is [`sharingan`](../sharingan/SKILL.md) § 6's** — one round after
[`hanten`](../hanten/SKILL.md) settles, never before — and this skill makes only the first request, of `base_reviewers`,
never of a CI lane (PROCESS, *Event-driven reviewer lanes*).
[PROCESS.md](../../../docs/PROCESS.md) § *Reviewer rounds and review threads* owns token and bot mechanics.

**Then one line, and stop:** notation, base, forecast gate, check results, quoted Development
guard line, evidence mechanism, any § 1 permission stop, requested reviewers and Mukai's En offer
(or autoEn start). No `nen stop` banner: En owns the Ready event and its bell.

## 6. Residue, authority and hard limits

Named raw calls: [`PROCESS.md`](../../../docs/PROCESS.md) § *Residue and owned dependencies*.

- **Permitted, only on the maintainer's own `$mukai` or `$shibari` call:** read the working
  copy and its history; write the body file; open **one** PR against `branch.base` from the last
  pushed commit; edit **that** PR's body; request reviewers; run the target's own declared
  evidence-publish step on `public-mirror`. **The delegation is one run wide.**
- **Not permitted:** any merge, label, review vote or commit; any push, force-push or `--no-verify`,
  even to satisfy its own precondition; a second PR, or one for a branch whose `HEAD` is ahead of
  `origin/<branch>`; touching a PR this run did not open.
- **Never opens a PR missing a declared body requirement (§ 4), or the `changelog.d/` fragment
  where one is owed** — decided by verb.
- **Never writes a section with no fact behind it**, and **never ticks a completion box by assertion**.
- **Never stages a capture that is not one of the branch's re-recorded test artifacts**, and never
  treats an untracked evidence gap as a sanctioned incompleteness.
- **Never passes a body as an inline `--body` string**, reports a reviewer as requested when the call
  no-opped, or reports a missing Development link as present.
- **Never presents by-hand `git`/`gh` as a verb's output.**
